name: slash-menu
title: Slash menu
author: Eduardo Retana
description: A slash command menu anchored to a textarea.

meta.descriptionEs: Un menú de comandos con barra, anclado a un área de texto.

examples.title: Menú de barras
examples.description: Un menú de comandos con barra, anclado a un área de texto.

meta.usage: const slash = useSlashTrigger(ref); <SlashMenu commands={commands} open={slash.open} query={slash.query} onSelect={pick} onDismiss={slash.close} />

docs: Adapted from LocalMode UI (MIT). Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a primitive the host already has. The item ships no theme, cssVars, or fixed colors. Decorative motion stops when the reader prefers reduced motion.
